units.source_text: 源氏公子照例常在宫中住宿数日。

en.t: Prince Genji, as usual, often stayed for several days at the palace.

units.source_text: 有一次，他选定一个应向中川方面避凶的禁忌日，

en.t: One time, he chose an unlucky abstinence day when he was supposed to avoid misfortune by going toward Nakagawa,

units.source_text: 装作从宫中返邸时突然想起的样子，

en.t: and pretended that he had suddenly remembered something while returning from the palace to his residence,

units.source_text: 中途转向纪伊守家去了。

en.t: then turned aside on the way and went to the Governor of Kii's house.
The Governor of Kii was startled,

units.source_text: 以为他家池塘美景逗引公子再度光临，不胜荣幸。

en.t: and thought the beauty of his household pond had drawn the prince back again, which made him deeply honored.

units.source_text: 早间源氏公子已将计划告知小君，和他约定了办法。

en.t: Earlier that morning, Prince Genji had already told Kogimi of the plan and arranged the method with him.

units.source_text: 小君本来早晚随从，今夜当然同去。

en.t: Kogimi was normally in attendance morning and evening, so of course he went along that night as well.
Utsusemi had also received word of it.

units.source_text: 她想：“源氏公子作此计划，足见对我的情爱决非浅薄。

en.t: She thought, "The fact that Prince Genji has made such a plan shows that his feeling for me is certainly not shallow.

units.source_text: 但倘不顾身份，竭诚招待他，则又使不得，

en.t: But if I ignore my station and receive him with all my heart, that too would be impossible,

units.source_text: 势必重尝梦也似的过去了的那夜的痛苦。”

en.t: and I would surely have to taste again the pain of that night that passed like a dream."

units.source_text: 她心乱如麻，觉得在此等候光临，不胜羞耻。

en.t: Her heart was in complete turmoil, and she felt unbearably ashamed to wait there for his visit.

units.source_text: 便乘小君被源氏公子叫去之时对侍女们说：

en.t: So, taking advantage of the moment when Kogimi had been called away by Prince Genji, she said to her waiting women:

units.source_text: “这里和源氏公子的房间太接近了，很不方便。

en.t: "This room is far too close to Prince Genji's room, and it is very inconvenient.

units.source_text: 况且我今天身上不好，想教人捶捶肩背，迁居到远些的地方去吧。”

en.t: Besides, I am not feeling well today and want someone to rub my shoulders and back, so let us move somewhere farther away."

units.source_text: 就移居到廊下侍女中将所居的房间里，作为躲避之所。

en.t: She then moved to the room occupied by Chujo, a waiting woman in the corridor, and used it as a place to hide.
